record.title: R55 qualification topology learning
record.body: Durable learning: a new pull_request verifier cannot provide its own first trustworthy subject court unless its qualification topology is already default-owned. Admit two distinct modes instead of weakening the subject test: BOOTSTRAP mode validates exact-head verifier topology while explicitly refusing to claim subject standing; SUBJECT mode preserves the complete subject CTQ. After topology admission, broad real-ggen qualification remains an independent falsifier and can discover production defects invisible to the semantic owning court. R55 proved this twice: strict-mode generation required ORDER BY on the evidence-return SELECT, then ggen's template ABI required result iteration via `results`, not `rows`. General rule: bootstrap verifier topology -> subject court -> real generator/runtime court -> merge only after all exact-subject rails converge.
